items.title: ECB Seeks Partners for Appia Tokenized Finance Tests
items.summary: Applications for the first exercises are due Dec. 11, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis. The call includes deposit-settlement tests using mock central bank money.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Chainflip Halts Swaps Over Potential Vault Exploit
items.summary: Deposits, withdrawals and quotes are disabled. A security monitor flagged Ethereum vault outflows it valued at about $4.86 million.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Aave Voters Back Plan to Narrow V3 Core Collateral
items.summary: Existing loans would stay open as LlamaRisk’s plan steers borrowers toward retained collateral or Aave V4.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitcoin Hits $55,106 on Coinbase, Lowest Since September 2024
items.summary: Coinbase's low left bitcoin 35.1% below its Oct. 21 intraday high. Kraken recorded $55,100 in the same minute.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Masullo’s Riemann Claim Draws AI-Assisted Objections
items.summary: Vakil reported AI-assisted objections to Masullo’s draft. A separate Claude-assisted proof has passed independent formal checks, according to an MIT mathematician.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitcoin Core Fixes AI-Found Bug That Could Stall Nodes
items.summary: Versions 30.5 and 31.3 patch a medium-severity flaw found through Spiral’s Loupe scanner. The retired 29.x branch will not get a fix.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: XRP Sets New November Low on Coinbase, Down 10% in 24 Hours
items.summary: XRP fell to $0.8663 late Friday, below its Nov. 14 trough. Its daily loss matched the broader selloff, while its weekly decline was smaller than bitcoin's and ether's.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitcoin Hits $55,500 as Strategy's Paper Loss Deepens
items.summary: Strategy's disclosed bitcoin holdings were about $16.8 billion below their purchase cost as the cryptocurrency traded more than 26% below the company's average acquisition price.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitcoin Falls 8% as Liquidations Reach $2.38 Billion
items.summary: Long positions accounted for 92.6% of CoinGlass's rolling 24-hour liquidation total, with 343,889 traders liquidated.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Ether Slides Near $1,550, Down About 35% in Four Weeks
items.summary: Bitcoin lost about 31% over the same window, while declines in Solana, BNB and Hyperliquid underscored the broader selloff.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $57,000 to Two-Year Low on Coinbase
items.summary: Coinbase's $56,747 low put bitcoin 33.1% below its Oct. 21 intraday high, taking it further below June's trough.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitquery Traces at Least $1.58 Million in Fluidkey Hack
items.summary: Fluidkey says a logging-tool flaw let an attacker trigger transfers when users opened the app, even though private keys stayed on their devices.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: PancakeSwap Volume Rebounds 34% to $991 Million
items.summary: BNB Chain accounted for $828 million of daily trading, while PancakeSwap’s weekly growth trailed Uniswap, Curve and Raydium.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Sky Buybacks and Rewards Exceed Revenue in Llama Data
items.summary: DefiLlama measured about $440,000 in revenue after estimated savings costs on Nov. 20, below its $827,000 valuation of buybacks and staking rewards.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Sky TVL Falls 45% in a Week as USDC Reserve Shrinks
items.summary: Sky's tracked assets fell to $2.24 billion in the Nov. 20 daily snapshot. A large decline in its USDC conversion reserve corroborates the contraction.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Clayton Links Tech Outages to Maintenance and Upgrades
items.summary: The intelligence chief described separate outages linked to maintenance and technical changes. Mark Warner pointed to pressure to patch AI-found flaws.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Aave V4 Plan Would Put Idle USDC Into Circle Gateway
items.summary: New sweeps would have to keep Gateway exposure within 10 million USDC and 25% of supply, while preserving cash for withdrawals and loans.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: S&P 500 Sinks 3.7%, Extending Slide to Seven Sessions
items.summary: The index lost 8.6% for the week, while bitcoin also declined sharply over the past week.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Oracle Says OpenAI Infrastructure Deal Is Fully Funded
items.summary: The company says vendor financing is in place after November stock and bond sales, with Nvidia rack handovers at Shackelford still on track.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Cloudflare Adds Ruby2Shell Rules; Ruby Patch Still Needed
items.summary: Free-plan rules run automatically; paid sites need deployed, unoverridden managed rules. Traffic bypassing Cloudflare remains outside the shield, so Ruby still needs patching.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Mini for Local AI
items.summary: The roughly 20GB model supports Apple silicon devices with 32GB or more memory. Its Apache 2.0 listing comes with a separate acceptable-use policy.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: 44 Attorneys General Challenge CFTC Prediction Rules
items.summary: The coalition says federal derivatives oversight cannot replace state gambling safeguards. One rule remains proposed; its companion is already in effect.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: SEC Proposes Direct Control of Consolidated Audit Trail
items.summary: The agency intends to use congressional appropriations for CAT operations, while exchanges and broker-dealers would keep reporting substantially the same data.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: December Fed Hike Odds Ease in Futures-Based Monitor
items.summary: Investing.com’s monitor put December hike odds at 93.6%, down from 99.6% in its previous-day snapshot, while still overwhelmingly favoring an increase.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Nvidia Slides Nearly 10% as Nasdaq 100 Falls Sharply
items.summary: Reuters reported that SEC investigators are examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia, adding detail to a probe first reported on Nov. 17.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $58,000 but Holds Above June Low
items.summary: Friday's low was less than $200 above Coinbase's June trough. The high-to-low decline from Oct. 21 reached 31.8%.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: BENQI Plans New Queue to Shorten sAVAX Unstaking Waits
items.summary: Pending unstaking requests will carry over without losing time already waited, while existing holders will not need to move or swap their tokens.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Stock Market Cap: What It Measures and What Losses Mean
items.summary: With the share count unchanged, a falling price reduces quoted equity value. It does not, by itself, drain company cash or establish an operating loss.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Sky's USDC Exit Reserve Rises 29% to 1.13 Billion
items.summary: The shared USDS and DAI conversion reserve gained 254 million USDC between midday snapshots, but remained well below its level at the start of Nov. 19.
items.author: The Defiant

items.title: Wagyu Operator Pledges Refunds After XMR1 Sell-Off
items.summary: Scam Sniffer estimated the token sales brought in about $13.3 million in USDC. PerpetualCow pledged to cover losses personally.
items.author: The Defiant
